resources.string:
RunPro exports finished runs synced from your watch into Health Connect so apps such as Samsung Health can display them.

RunPro requests write-only access for:
• Running exercise sessions and laps
• GPS exercise routes
• Heart rate series
• Distance
• Steps

RunPro does not read health data written by other apps.
Health Connect is available. Grant permissions to export received runs.
Health Connect needs an update before RunPro can export runs.
Health Connect is unavailable on this device.
Health Connect permissions are missing. Tap Grant Health Connect permissions first.
